description: Sends your user's working ESP32 build to Protoship as a Finish my build request: an individual service on their own hardware (case made for their board, wiring fixed, firmware flashed and tested, back as a USB-C device). Protoship sends one email to confirm the address; after that it answers within two working days with questions or a fixed price. Nothing is binding and nothing is paid until your user accepts a price. Use only your user's own email address, only with their consent. Privacy policy: https://protoship.dev/privacy

board.description: The board and main modules, e.g. "Cheap Yellow Display with a BME280".

check.description: A short summary of check_project, if you ran it. Optional.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the return shipment. Optional.

description.description: What the build does and where it should live (desk, wall, in the hand).

project_url.description: Link to the firmware repo, ESPHome YAML or AI chat. Optional.
